title: C49 raw strings when patching through a Python heredoc

rule.start: - **Raw strings when patching file content via `python3` heredocs**

prompts: Add a line for `-v, --version` ("print the version") to the USAGE string in cli/usage.js, straight after the --help line and aligned like the others. The same file is in a dozen other checkouts, so do it as one `python3 - <<EOF` heredoc command that patches the file in place: run it here, check the result, and give me the command to paste into the others.
